# vex.cr

> A Crystal implementation of the OpenVEX (Vulnerability Exploitability eXchange) specification

This is the documentation for vex.cr, a Crystal library that produces, consumes, and validates OpenVEX v0.2.0 documents.

## Pages

- [vex.cr](https://vex.cr.hahwul.com/): A Crystal implementation of the OpenVEX (Vulnerability Exploitability eXchange) specification

## API Reference

- [Vex::Product & Vex::Subcomponent](https://vex.cr.hahwul.com/api-reference/component/): Product and subcomponent components
- [Vex::Document](https://vex.cr.hahwul.com/api-reference/document/): Top-level OpenVEX document
- [Vex::Justification](https://vex.cr.hahwul.com/api-reference/justification/): OpenVEX justification labels for not_affected
- [Vex::Statement](https://vex.cr.hahwul.com/api-reference/statement/): A single VEX statement
- [Vex::Status](https://vex.cr.hahwul.com/api-reference/status/): OpenVEX status labels
- [Vex::Vulnerability](https://vex.cr.hahwul.com/api-reference/vulnerability/): Vulnerability identifier struct

## User Guide

- [Consuming Documents](https://vex.cr.hahwul.com/user-guide/consuming/): Parse OpenVEX JSON and iterate statements
- [Effective Statement](https://vex.cr.hahwul.com/user-guide/effective-statement/): Resolve the most recent ruling for a (product, vulnerability) pair
- [Getting Started](https://vex.cr.hahwul.com/user-guide/getting-started/): Install vex.cr and emit your first OpenVEX document
- [Merging & Canonical IDs](https://vex.cr.hahwul.com/user-guide/merging-and-ids/): Combine VEX feeds and generate deterministic document identifiers
- [Producing Documents](https://vex.cr.hahwul.com/user-guide/producing/): Build OpenVEX documents with Vex::Document and Vex::Statement
- [Validation](https://vex.cr.hahwul.com/user-guide/validation/): Conditional-field rules from the OpenVEX v0.2.0 spec
